apps.versionDescription:
YouTube 21.24.3 | YouProExtra_21.24.3_1.3.1

### Latest Stable Release, ENJOY!!
> [!NOTE]
> - Bundled with **YTUHD**.
> - Updated Gonerino and YT Headers. 
> - if you're signed out you can sign in manually. 
> - - -
> #### Extra Tweaks:
> - `YouPip` `YTUHD` `YouSlider` `YTweaks` `YouSpeed` `YouMute` `YouLoop` `YTABConfig` `YouQuality` `YouChooseQuality`  `YouGetCaption` 
> -  `Return-YouTube-Dislikes` `DontEatMyContent` `iSponsorBlock` `Open in YouTube (Safari Extension)` `Gonerino` 

> [!WARNING]
> - Limited Support for new YT versions.(+21.25.5). 21.24.3 is the latest build that works with extra tweaks.
